title: Add webhook signature verification (HMAC) for GitHub webhooks
description:
Implement HMAC signature verification for GitHub webhook requests to prevent unauthorized webhook calls. This is a security enhancement to validate that webhook POSTs actually come from GitHub.

Currently, the webhook endpoints accept any POST request without verification. We need to verify the X-Hub-Signature-256 header using a webhook secret.
